title: ISAIAH 58:8
HEALING LIGHT
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: peaceful white dove flying in sky

scenes.a: If the silence in your room feels heavy with uncertainty, stay for this moment.
We come before the Father to seek his restoration in this quiet, holy time.
Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
Lord, touch the areas of exhaustion and pain that weigh upon the soul right now.
May your presence settle over this tired mind, bringing deep comfort and internal rest.
We trust in your timing and your infinite grace to mend what is broken.
